component.name: Notepad3
component.summary: Fast and light-weight Scintilla-based text editor with syntax highlighting

description.p: This is a community package of Notepad3, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified. Notepad3 is a Windows application, so this package runs the vendor's own x64 portable build under the Wine compatibility layer, provided by the official org.winehq.Wine Flatpak base.

Notepad3 is a fast and light-weight Scintilla-based text editor with syntax highlighting. It has a small memory footprint, but is powerful enough to handle most programming jobs: the editing component is the same one SciTE uses, extended with code folding, case conversion, accent-free transliteration, block indentation, whitespace trimming, line sorting, brace matching, comment toggling, encoding conversion and conversion between Unix, Mac and DOS line endings.

ul.li: Syntax highlighting for dozens of languages and file formats, with multiple color themes and word-wrap
Regular-expression find and replace (backreferences, substitution counters), incremental search and a persistent find band
grepWin integration for regex-based search and replace across directories, plus the bundled minipath file browser
Support for very long lines and large files, Unicode, UTF-8, UTF-16 and many ANSI code pages
Optional file encryption with the bundled np3encrypt tool
Portable or installed settings, dark mode, multi-level undo, bookmark and marker management

description.p: Being upstream's Windows build running under Wine, the interface looks and behaves like the Windows version. Settings, favorites and the Wine prefix are kept in this application's own data directory.

Your home directory is granted by default, because Notepad3's own file dialogs are Windows dialogs that browse the host through Wine's Z: drive and cannot use the desktop portal's file chooser. A few further capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Open and save files on removable media (USB drives, SD cards): flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/media com.rizonesoft.Notepad3
Follow symlinks into locations outside the sandbox that you have granted separately: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-config/com.rizonesoft.Notepad3:create com.rizonesoft.Notepad3

description.p: New upstream releases are picked up by FlatPark and delivered through "flatpak update".
